description: Hybrid L0 overview / Fleet Command Center. First screen: status strip, compact First Action route, and Review Domain Status evidence matrix above fold. Aggregate-first triage; exact run forensics via Run Explorer and Trust. run_id is HTTP identity context only — never a Prometheus label.

panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus 0–4: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Provider Health / Data Quality. Adjunct 5–6: Incident Workspace / Run Explorer. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions. Chip colors are theme-safe for dark and light.

options.content:
What is broken or degraded right now?
CURRENT = Status + First Action. TIME RANGE = Domain Status.

panels.description: Distinguishes CURRENT Prometheus state, SELECTED RUN persisted HTTP evidence, and TIME RANGE history. Pipeline and Run Type affect current and historical evidence; Run ID never filters Prometheus. UNKNOWN means missing or stale evidence, never healthy. To inspect a selected run, set a concrete run_id (not -) after choosing pipeline/run_type. Default run_id=- keeps fleet/current status only — exact identity/processed-record panels stay empty until a run is selected. Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser.
panels.title: Inspect Scope & Evidence
Review Selected Run Summary
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Compact pipeline_run_report_v1 projection (identity, times, gold out, contract exclusions, coverage). This strip is the selected UUID, not CURRENT fleet. Missing run is VALID EMPTY / SELECT RUN, not OK. Do not treat Monitor Fleet Health or Review First Action as this run. Backend unavailable means the query could not be evaluated. Verify /health/live. Coverage chip is IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN from covers_selected_run. Set range to run opens Run Explorer 3022 at from_ms..to_ms. A covered run does not show an outside-range warning.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first. VALID EMPTY if the selected run has no report.
UNKNOWN

panels.title: Monitor Fleet Health
panels.description: CURRENT · Sole current Fleet Health verdict for pipeline x run_type. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN means evidence is incomplete or missing. This is not the selected UUID; use Review Selected Run Summary above for that run.

panels.title: Review First Action

defaults.noValue: No route for this scope

panels.description: TIME RANGE · CURRENT · Open Action on the top row first — routes are ranked by urgency (RUNTIME > CP > GOLD > DQ > PROV > WF > MON). MON/NR means keep watching when Fleet Health is OK.  Scope: current fleet/status verdict for selected pipeline, workflow, and time range; not a per-run_id metric. NO_ROUTE/no_route appears only when the selected scope has no route series (absent(route)*no_route); it is not a healthy empty and does not mean the dashboard selector widget is blank. Gold lifecycle blocked / DQ issue here is CURRENT fleet routing, not a verdict for the selected run_id. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Review Domain Status

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — no domain status for this scope

panels.description: CURRENT · TIME RANGE · Shows the four worst current domain statuses for the selected scope, ranked UNKNOWN/CRIT/WARN before OK. Values are 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, and null/3=UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN means incomplete evidence, not OK. The complete six-domain matrix remains in Domain Status Tracks. Open the affected domain for detail. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Inspect Alerts
Review Active Alerts
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows firing and pending BioETL alerts from Prometheus for the active time range. An inactive row means no active alert was observed; an empty result or UNKNOWN means alert evidence is unavailable, not OK. Continue in Pipeline Diagnostics for blocker scope. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — no events in the selected range (not missing telemetry)

panels.description: Contains selected-range alert evidence for triage. It supports investigation but does not determine current Fleet Health; expand it after the first-screen verdict points to an alert condition.

panels.title: Review All Domain Status

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — no domain status for this scope

panels.description: CURRENT · TIME RANGE · Complete current Control Plane, Runtime, Provider, Data Quality, Data Validation, and Workflow matrix for the selected scope. Values are 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, and null/3=UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN means incomplete evidence, not OK. This is the full first-screen companion to the four-row Review Domain Status summary. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Track Runtime Blockers

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

This trend does not determine current Fleet Health; open Pipeline Diagnostics for current blockers. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Role: history (state-timeline) of L1 runtime over the range; the snapshot table is Review Runtime Status (9003).

panels.title: Inspect Range Evidence
panels.description: Contains selected-range run, terminal-state, and reject evidence. Empty history is not proof of current health, and these panels do not determine current Fleet Health.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.description: TIME RANGE · SELECTED RUN · Lists failed-run samples in the selected range for Pipeline and Run Type. No rows means no matching failures were observed, not proof that current Fleet Health is OK; missing telemetry remains UNKNOWN. Open Pipeline Diagnostics to localize failures. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.description: TIME RANGE · SELECTED RUN · Lists recent non-success terminal runs in the selected range, grouped by Pipeline. No rows means no matching terminal evidence, not proof that current Fleet Health is OK. Continue in Trust for persisted run evidence or Pipeline Diagnostics for execution detail. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Track Silver Rejects

defaults.noValue: None observed

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows Silver reject count and rate for the selected range and scope. Zero can mean no rejects only when a run started and matching telemetry is present; no matching scope, a run not started, or missing evidence remains UNKNOWN. This panel does not determine current Fleet Health; use Data Quality or Run Explorer. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.

panels.title: Inspect Domain Diagnostics
panels.description: Contains current domain summaries and diagnostic routing. It supports the first-screen verdict and stays collapsed until Domain Status or First Action identifies an affected area.

list.label: Run Type
list.name: run_type
list.description: Core scope: run_type selector bounded by pipeline; fallback: All run types for selected pipeline.

Run ID selector sourced from the local control-plane run-manifest catalog for the current pipeline/run_type scope. Grafana All values are normalized to an unbounded scope, so Run Type = All no longer empties the selector; Pipeline = All exposes aggregate exact-run handoff options from the catalog. This selector remains HTTP-backed and does not reintroduce run_id into Prometheus labels. Run ID options are ordered by start time descending from the control-plane catalog; Grafana sort is disabled so backend order is preserved.
